description: This file defines the GaussianMixtureModel class for representing and working with Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) in Spark's MLlib. It includes methods for prediction, soft assignment, saving, and loading models, and defines the companion object for serialization.

classes.name: GaussianMixtureModel
classes.description: Represents a Gaussian Mixture Model with methods for prediction, soft assignment, and persistence.

methods.name: k
methods.description: Returns the number of Gaussians in the mixture.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts cluster indices for an RDD of vectors.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts the cluster index for a single vector.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Java-friendly method to predict cluster indices for a JavaRDD of vectors.

methods.name: predictSoft
methods.description: Returns the membership probabilities of each vector to all mixture components.

methods.name: predictSoft
methods.description: Returns the membership probabilities of a single vector to all mixture components.

methods.name: computeSoftAssignments
methods.description: Computes the soft assignment probabilities for a vector.
